item.title: Jazz in the Plaza — Sun Sep 27, 1:00 PM — Putnam Plaza
item.description:
Every Sunday: Free, live jazz every week performed by some of the best musicians in the SF Bay Area and beyond, right in the heart of downtown Petaluma! Every Sunday from 1 to 3:30, local jazz bassist and music book publisher Chuck Sher presents a rotating ensemble of professional, veteran jazz musicians in Putnam Plaza Park, right next to the Speakeasy. This event started in 2020 and has since become a staple for locals and visitors alike. Stop by and enjoy some of the best jazz the Bay Area has to offer!
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: SBC # 577 Dr. Richard Boyd - How Much Can We REALLY Know About the Afterlife? Former Science Director, National Ignition Facility at Lawrence Livermore National Lab A Physicist’s Perspective — Mon Sep 28, 6:00 PM — Hopmonk Tavern Sebastopol
item.description:
A Physicist’s Perspective Do you doubt the existence of an afterlife? Richard will take a ‘scientific approach’, as he explores data claiming to prove that an afterlife exists. Could the most recent data and claims open the possibility that an afterlife, a supra-sensory existence, is linked to our apparently limited sensory existence? This study will include reincarnation data, near death experiences, pastlife regressions, and information from mediums – always with a physicist’s perspective. Comments and Questions from the audience are encouraged!
Source: Sebastopol Calendar
